testcase.name: importing twice adds nothing the second time
dishes the app has under another name are left alone
the csv reader handles what a spreadsheet writes
the second language moves from the name to the aliases
a dish with calories but no macros is declined, not zeroed
nothing imported duplicates a built-in food
a countable thing keeps its own unit, a vessel becomes per 100
every dish is accounted for once
drinks file under drinks and every category is one the app already uses
numbers are rescaled, not copied, when the unit changes
an empty or header-only file imports nothing and does not throw
a dish that is mostly fat by weight is declined
a dish whose calories contradict its own macros is declined
nothing imported passes a gate the built-in foods would fail
